selection: one equilibrium candidate and one exploitation candidate, locked before play

preflopPack.alternatives: v2 and v4 are separately identified diagnostics, not interchangeable with v3

units: bb/100; shark results are opponent winnings

styles.comparison: paired same deals baseline/candidate; never pool tables before computing style estimates

duplicate.score: (forward A score - mirrored B score)/2; preserve pair then cluster by seed/session

shark2Fast.role: additional veto and diagnostic, never a global exploitability bound

slumbot.confirmation: three predeclared 16000-hand batches; publish all; no early stopping
slumbot.seedMeaning: our action RNG only; Slumbot controls deals

estimators.aivat: raw plus exact action controls; singleton partitions; omit unsupported nodes with explicit coverage; exact late-board chance controls when both holes are known for every hand
estimators.chanceHeuristic: exact showdown share against actual holding, turn and river only
estimators.allInPreflop: existing seeded 4000-runout Monte Carlo; approximate, explicitly labeled
estimators.varianceGate: raw SE/AIVAT SE >= 2 AND all-in-valued SE/AIVAT SE >= 2 on identical observations and clusters
estimators.clustering: session for duplicate/styles/shark; run for adaptive Slumbot, hand for no-memory Slumbot
estimators.missingness: failures, missing strategy mass, replay disagreements and missing provenance prevent qualification

recipe.publicState: pre-decision board, both seats stacks and contributions; own hole indexes the output only
recipe.ranges: snapshot tracked solver ranges conditioned on public tree path, OOP first; no future actions or opponent hole; unchanged across alternatives
recipe.buckets: same exact training layout: river strengthRanks, turn expectedStrengthRanks over every river, flop expectedStrengthRanks over every next card; export-specific bucket metadata honored
recipe.projection: for each legal alternative, opponent matches our new street contribution if affordable; evaluate resulting pot and effective stack with PRE-action ranges; Q = output[actor bucket] * projectedPot - actor.betHand - actionCost
recipe.unavailable: omit postflop action nodes without tracked ranges or exact strategy; record reason; never reconstruct historical policy probabilities from a present policy
recipe.controls: exact legalised sampler probabilities; sum(p * Q) - Q(taken); no fitted correction coefficient; v1 exact late-board chance controls unchanged
recipe.tuning: no outcome-dependent calibration, coefficients, clamping, model selection or early stopping
recipe.precision: network outputs may be inaccurate, especially facing bets or all-in: matching projection ignores fold equity; stronger representation does not imply lower variance
recipe.validation: enumerable toy with fixed network-derived Q and exact action centering; frozen source/export/spec hashes
recipe.evaluation: existing logs are retrospective; action AIVAT unavailable without records; report available chance controls separately; future qualification requires freezing before fresh collection

D2.reason: No numeric D2 definition available in supplied facts or located files; cannot declare pass

B6.source: B6 v2 design acceptance, 2026-10-23; older +20 practice gate superseded

freezeRule: Hash this JSON plus code, models and packs before play. Any change creates a new benchmark version. Existing results are retrospective, not fresh held-out confirmation.
